snippet.title: Mr. Zippy is Watching (Trailer)
snippet.description:
"Mr. Zippy is Watching" is a short mascot horror narrative experience, where you folloe the objectives until the end of the story and interact with the house.

Remember when you were a little kid that didn't behave? One night, when you were supposed to be asleep, you snuck into the living room to watch a late night show about urban legends. Your favorite toy, Mr. Zippy, is tonight's topic and you start getting paranoid about the one you have in your bedroom...

This game was originally made for the 2026 Mascot Horror Game Jam.

Play it on our itch.io page: https://bluememories.itch.io/mr-zippy
Follow us on our socials: https://linktr.ee/bluememoriestt
